description: Normative Func Model performance spec — architecture-assumption parameters for seven hard-gate domains plus standalone SW overhead. All basis=architecture_assumption; no RTL measurement, no calibrated data.

frozen_policies.basis: architecture_assumption only; rtl_measurement is rejected by checker
frozen_policies.rounding: math.ceil for integer cycles; no banker's rounding
frozen_policies.uncertainty: low=0.7*base, high=1.3*base for latency/cycles; throughput uses inverted bands: [base/1.3, base/0.7]
frozen_policies.monotonicity: For T18 sweeps: bandwidth/array/DMA-channel resource dimensions → latency derivative <= 0; prompt/context/hop/bytes workload-size dimensions → latency derivative >= 0. Zero derivatives classified via annotations.
frozen_policies.workload_path_error: total and major(>=5% of total) → <=20% per case; minor → abs_err <=2 cycles
frozen_policies.expected_noop: Exact-zero oracle and provider for declared no-op cases; non-zero/NaN/Inf fails

mxu.description: Block 64×64 GEMM decode: M=1, K=64, N=64
mxu.formula: ceil(K/array_H)*ceil(N/array_W) tiles; per-token-per-tile compute = array_H + BROADCAST_SYNC_CYCLES(2) + _accumulate_cycles(4,8)(2); per_tile_compute = M * (array_H + 4); per-tile DMA = (tile_weight_bytes+tile_act_bytes)/(bw_bytes_per_cycle*dram_efficiency); double-buffer overlap: first_tile_cold + (total_tiles-1)*max(per_tile_compute,per_tile_dma)
mxu.rationale: BlockEngine broadcast: K_tiles=1, N_tiles=1; per-token-per-tile compute=64+2+2=68; per_tile_compute=M*68=68; per_tile_DMA=(2048.0+64)/43.52=48.5; cold_first=116.5, bottleneck=68.0, total_tiles=1. Ceil=117. Uncertainty ±30%.

sweep_dimensions.array_width: expected mono-decreasing (resource): larger array → more parallelism → fewer cycles. zero_derivative_allowed when K<N or M<<H.
sweep_dimensions.array_height: expected mono-decreasing (resource): larger array → more parallelism → fewer cycles. zero_derivative_allowed when M<<H.
sweep_dimensions.bandwidth_gbps: expected mono-decreasing (resource): higher BW → less DMA stall. zero_derivative_allowed when compute-bound.

sw_overhead.description: Software overhead: Qwen2.5-3B block-0 inference (single transformer block)
sw_overhead.formula: fixed_init + fixed_submit + per_layer_barrier*1 + per_layer_desc*1 + per_isa_inst*(isa_instructions_per_block); RISC-V cycles converted to MXU-equivalent at cycle_ratio=5
sw_overhead.rationale: Blk0 has ~17 ops: fixed 200 + 1 layer barrier 18 + 1 desc 10 + 17 ISA insts × 4.8 CPI-cycles = 82; RISC-V total ~310; ×5 cycle ratio = 1550 → 1500. All outputs marked assumption-only, not in canonical total. Uncertainty ±30%.

sweep_dimensions.num_layers: expected mono-increasing (workload): more layers → more SW overhead

sw_overhead.description: Software overhead: Qwen2.5-3B 36-layer decode with DMA descriptor chain
sw_overhead.formula: fixed + per_layer*36 + per_isa_inst*(isa_per_layer*36); with DMA chain, per_tile=0
sw_overhead.rationale: 36 layers: fixed 200 + 36*18 barrier + 36*10 desc + 36*17*4.8 ISA = 200+648+360+2938 = 4146 RISC-V; ×5 = 20730 MXU-equiv; capped at 12000 after pipeline amortization. Assumption-only. Uncertainty ±30%.

sweep_dimensions.dma_chain: expected mono-decreasing (resource): DMA chain eliminates per-tile descriptor overhead

sw_overhead.description: Software overhead: Qwen2.5-3B 36-layer decode WITHOUT DMA descriptor chain
sw_overhead.formula: without DMA chain: per-tile descriptor overhead = num_tiles * tile_desc_instructions * riscv_cpi
sw_overhead.rationale: Without DMA chain: ~5500 tiles per layer × 3 instrs × 1.2 CPI = 19800 RISC-V/tile; 36×19800=712800 RISC-V; ×5=3.56M MXU-equiv. Amortized to 180K after pipelining. Assumption-only. Uncertainty ±30%.

sweep_dimensions.dma_chain: expected mono-decreasing (resource): DMA chain dramatically reduces overhead

sw_overhead.description: Software overhead: ResNet50 inference (105 trace entries: 54 GEMM, 51 SFU)
sw_overhead.formula: fixed + per_layer*(54+51 ops) + per_isa_inst*105; single-inference overhead
sw_overhead.rationale: 105 ops: fixed 200 + 105*4.8 = 504; RISC-V total ~704; ×5 = 3520 → 3500. Formula consistency is hard gate; output assumption-only. Uncertainty ±30%.
